newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Deep freeze hits shipping in port of Rotterdam.
newsitem.headline: Deep freeze hits shipping in port of Rotterdam.

text.p: Freezing weather hit the port of Rotterdam on Thursday with barging sources reporting that loading and discharging was virtually impossible at many jetties.
"We cannot now reach the jetties. This is all along the Maas, until Europoort. There, at least, it's salt water," a barging operator said.
Europoort, at the coast, handles crude oil discharges and is also the site of one of Nerefco's two Rotterdam-based refineries as well as the Kuwait Petroleum Plant.
The other Nerefco refinery and those of Esso and Shell lie further upstream.
Rotterdam has until now been largely unaffected by sub-zero temperatures which have hit continental Europe for the past two weeks.
Nerefco is a joint venture between Texaco and British Petroleum.
